title: baba-is-auto native level file (text)
description: Whitespace-separated integers. Header 'W H', then 1-3 layers of W*H tile IDs in row-major order (y outer, x inner). Layer k holds the k-th object of each cell; ICON_EMPTY (132) pads. Optional trailing 'DIRECTIONS' block with one 0-3 value per tile.

directions.description: 0=RIGHT 1=UP 2=LEFT 3=DOWN; if present, exactly one per tile value

x-conventions.coordinates: zero-based (x, y), origin top-left, y grows downward
x-conventions.object_ids: assigned column-major at load (AssignObjectIDs); not stored in the file

x-forge-policy.comment: Stricter limits applied by this blueprint so the exhaustive solver stays tractable
